annotations.title: Account: sign up, balance, buy credits

description: Everything about your QuassLabs API account, chosen by `action`. Free: no action costs credits. "signup" (no API key needed): request a free key for an email address. A confirmation link is emailed; a human opens it on quasslabs.com to see the key, which is never returned to the agent. The key comes with 300 free credits a month. Always answers status check_email, whether or not the address already has a key. Needs email, accept_terms (true, after the human has agreed to https://quasslabs.com/api/terms) and terms_version. "balance" (API key required): what the calling key can spend - purchased credit_balance, free_credits left this UTC month, when they reset, plan and key_id. Daily free-tier caps still apply, so a free call can return 429 free_tier_busy while free_credits is above 0. Use it before a batch of paid calls or after a 402 insufficient_credits. "buy_credits" (API key required): a Stripe Checkout link for a human to pay in a browser; starter pack $5 for 500 credits, pro pack $20 for 2500. Credits land on this key once payment succeeds. "checkout_status" (no API key needed): whether a checkout session from buy_credits has been paid and its credits granted.

accept_terms.description: signup only. Must be true: the human owning the email has read and accepted the QL API Terms at https://quasslabs.com/api/terms.

action.description: What to do. signup and checkout_status work without an API key; balance and buy_credits need the key you are calling with.

email.description: signup only. The address to send the confirmation link to. A human must be able to read this inbox.

pack.description: buy_credits only. "starter" ($5 / 500 credits, the default) or "pro" ($20 / 2500 credits).

packs.description: buy_credits only. How many of that pack. Defaults to 1.

session_id.description: checkout_status only. The session_id that buy_credits returned (starts with cs_live_ or cs_test_).

terms_version.description: signup only. Version of the terms that were accepted, as shown on https://quasslabs.com/api/terms, e.g. "2026-11-07".
